listing_info.listing_name: Cabin with private hot tub near Toulouse
listing_info.description:
Treat yourself to an enchanted break in this cabin room nestled in the heart of nature, just 10 minutes from Toulouse. From your terrace, admire a breathtaking view of the pink city and the majestic peaks of the Pyrenees.

Designed for a moment of pure well-being, the cabin has an indoor sauna and an outdoor Nordic bath. Let the stress evaporate, breathe deeply...

✨ Breakfast is included, as is access to the sauna and hot tub.

The space
🛏 Night area & bedroom
Bright and warm, the room is a real bubble of comfort. It opens entirely onto the terrace thanks to a large bay window, offering panoramic views of nature, Toulouse and the Pyrenees in the distance. The queen-size bed awaits you with premium bedding, soft cotton sheets and a cozy plaid. The wood-burning stove adds a cozy touch to your winter evenings, while the carefully chosen decorative details (hanging lamps, light wood, natural materials) create an atmosphere that is both zen and elegant.

🚿 Bathroom
Discreetly integrated into the sleeping area, the open bathroom combines design and functionality. The walk-in shower, lined with a tinted glass wall, invites you to a refreshing break. Solid wood furniture, a round hanging mirror, golden faucets and eco-friendly toiletries complete this minimalist and refined relaxation space.

🔥 Indoor sauna
The private sauna, entirely dressed in natural wood, welcomes you for a moment of intense relaxation. Thanks to its large panoramic window, you can relax while admiring the surrounding nature. Perfect for deep relaxation, it offers you a unique Nordic experience just minutes from the city.

🌿 Terrace & outdoor Nordic bath
The large wooden terrace, facing south, extends the interior towards a landscaped garden with the feel of the end of the world. Enjoy the garden furniture for a sunny breakfast or a moment of reading in the shade. The wood-heated Nordic bath, installed out of sight, is the cherry on the cake: immerse yourself in hot water in the middle of nature, facing a grandiose panorama, day and night. Pure happiness.

🍃 A little extra included
Breakfast is included in the booking, as is unlimited access to the sauna and hot tub. A coffee machine, kettle, toaster, teas and treats are also available to start the day off right.

🌹Welcome to the Love Escape Space

✨ An elegant and glamorous 85 m² love room. ✨

Enjoy a large jacuzzi, walk-in shower and living room with equipped kitchen, TV, sofa and tantra sofa.

❤️ On the mezzanine: round bed, bathroom, pole dance bar and 20 m² hanging net above the living room with a swing.

🤫 A secret room awaits you to explore your most intimate desires...

🔐 Self access by digicode.

The space
The loft has an enclosed Jacuzzi area. From an open living room with kitchen and living room, you can access a private outdoor area with garden furniture.
The sleeping area is upstairs, on the mezzanine, closed by a net where you can safely venture!
The bathroom is located behind the sliding glass.

Guest access
Access to the loft is very simple! You have a camera-monitored parking lot right next door. The access door is anthracite gray with a keypad.

Other things to note
Accommodation capacity – Important information

The maximum authorized guest capacity is as indicated in the listing and included in your booking rate.

If you wish to host additional guests, this is only possible with the prior approval of our team. An additional fee of €25 per extra person will then be applied, whether this person stays overnight or is simply visiting during the stay.

Any person present in the accommodation without having been declared and authorized in advance will be considered an undeclared guest and will result in a flat fee of €100 per person.

This rule ensures compliance with the booking conditions, the safety of the occupants, and the smooth running of your stay.
